title: #onthisday I went to my first broadway show in nearly TWO years… and ...
transcript: Join me at the theater tonight. We're seeing Hadestown. 600 days ago, I sat in this very theater, and now here we are. Broadway musicals are back, and I couldn't dream of a better show to be my first show back. On the way to the theater, I actually ran into. I didn't say anything, but I was very excited. I'm a get to the theater right as it opens person. I just love being in the theater. Everyone was so bitty and welcoming and excited to be there. It was only the second performance since it reopened. It felt super safe because everyone had to be masked and vaccinated. Most of the original Broadway cast is back, with the notable exception of Patrick Page. But Tom Hewitt is in the role until November 2nd. He was great. Also, I bought some merch, which I definitely did not need. But you know what we are celebrating? We sat in the balcony, which is tiny and high up, but it's actually one of my favorite ways to watch the show. I love being able to see the whole stage and all the lighting. I can't believe I got to be here. I love Hadestown so much, and I'm just so happy.
